law.cross_owner: Source national ownership persists during travel and transfers only on physical arrival.
law.departure: Origin local civilian strata are debited immediately and the same bodies move into a national in-transit stratum.
law.routing: Every migration cohort requires a usable registered world route and an exact arrival time.
law.same_owner: National population_total never changes for internal movement.
law.throughput: No arbitrary migration cap. Movement is determined by conserved willing households, physical destination headroom, source pressure and route access.
